facts.statement: The genus Zuolong was described by Choiniere et al. in 2010.
facts.quote: authority: Choiniere et al., 2010

facts.statement: The name Zuolong honors General Zuo Zongtang, combining his name with the Chinese word for dragon.
facts.quote: The generic name of Zuolong is in honor of General Zuo Zōngtáng (also known as "General Tso") with the Chinese word "long" which means dragon.

facts.statement: The fossil of Zuolong was discovered in the Shishugou Formation in Xinjiang, China.
facts.quote: Zuolong was discovered in the upper part of the Wucaiwan member of the Shishugou Formation in Xinjiang, China.

facts.statement: Zuolong lived during the Oxfordian stage of the Late Jurassic period.
facts.quote: 40Ar/39Ar dating of volcanic feldspar at this locality places it at the span between the Callovian and Oxfordian boundary, and Zuolong was discovered in the upper part of this unit, which is interpreted as being Oxfordian in age.

facts.statement: The Zuolong specimen was discovered in 2001 but was not formally described until 2010.
facts.quote: The specimen was discovered in 2001 by the Sino-American field expedition, but it was not described until 2010

facts.statement: The description of Zuolong was published by Jonah Choiniere, James Clark, Catherine Forester, and Xu Xing.
facts.quote: Jonah Choiniere, James Clark, Catherine Forester, and Xu Xing published a full analysis of the bones.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen IVPP V15912 includes a partially complete skull and many post-cranial bones.
facts.quote: The holotype of Zuolong, given the designation IVPP V15912, consists of a partially complete skull and numerous post-cranial elements.

facts.statement: Gregory S. Paul hypothesized that the holotype is a juvenile and estimated an adult length of 3 meters and a mass of 50 kg.
facts.quote: Later, Gregory S. Paul suggested that the holotype is a juvenile and estimates a total adult length of 3 m and a mass of 50 kg.

facts.statement: Some authors suggest an adult Zuolong reached a length of 3.35 meters and a mass of 43 kg.
facts.quote: Other authors have suggested a larger adult size, giving a total length of 3.35 m meters and a mass of 43 kg kilograms.

facts.statement: Thomas R. Holtz Jr. considers the holotype specimen to almost certainly belong to a juvenile theropod.
facts.quote: The holotype is also considered by Thomas R. Holtz Jr. to almost certainly be from a juvenile theropod.

facts.statement: The skull of Zuolong is triangular-shaped with a snout that tapers significantly towards the end.
facts.quote: The skull is overall triangular-shaped, with a significant tapering towards the end of the snout.

facts.statement: Zuolong had very large lateral-facing orbits and a lacrimal bone process that created a small crest above the eyes.
facts.quote: It has very large orbits which face laterally and a pronounced anterior process of the lacrimal, which gives the appearance of a small crest above the eyes

facts.statement: Researchers estimated that Zuolong had four premaxillary and twelve maxillary teeth in life.
facts.quote: Choiniere and colleagues to estimate that in life, Zuolong likely had a total of four premaxillary and twelve maxillary teeth.

facts.statement: The preserved teeth of Zuolong are D-shaped in cross-section, a trait seen in tyrannosauroids but less convex than in those groups.
facts.quote: It is d-shaped in cross-section, which is the condition seen in tyrannosauroids, although they are not quite as convex as they are in those taxa.

facts.statement: It is debated whether the implications of Zuolong's discovery as one of the oldest known coelurosaurs can be fully understood without more fossil material.
facts.quote: Choiniere and colleagues noted that, at the time of its description, Zuolong was one of the oldest coelurosaurs known to science, but that the implications of its discovery cannot be fully understood until more fossil material is discovered.

facts.statement: The preserved skeleton of Zuolong includes twenty-two vertebrae from all four vertebral segments.
facts.quote: Twenty-two vertebrae are preserved, coming from all four vertebral segments.

facts.statement: The preserved manual claws of Zuolong are strongly curved and feature lateral grooves along their length.
facts.quote: The manual claws which are preserved are strongly curved and have lateral grooves down their length.

facts.statement: The hip bones of Zuolong display a supraacetabular crest extending from the posterior end of the acetabulum.
facts.quote: The hip bones display a supraacetabular crest which extends from the posterior end of the acetabulum.

facts.statement: An enlarged fovea capitis is an autapomorphy of Zuolong, though this feature is also known as a pathological condition in male turkeys.
facts.quote: One of the autapomorphies for Zuolong, the enlarged fovea capitis, is known to be a pathological condition in male turkeys

facts.statement: The fourth trochanter on the femur of Zuolong is positioned much higher than in more basal theropods.
facts.quote: The fourth trochanter is much higher up on the femur than it is in more basal theropods

facts.statement: The third metatarsal of Zuolong possesses a unique flange on the front-medial edge of its distal condyle.
facts.quote: they do have a unique feature in this part of the body which is a flange on the front-medial edge of the distal condyle of the third metatarsal

facts.statement: The most common hypothesis regarding Zuolong's taxonomy is that it is a basal member of Coelurosauria.
facts.quote: The most common hypothesis of the taxonomy of Zuolong is that it is a basal member of Coelurosauria.

facts.statement: In 2020, a group led by Brazilian paleontologist Juliana Manso Sayão described the new coelurosaur genus Aratasaurus from the Romualdo Formation.
facts.quote: In 2020, a group of several authors led by the Brazilian paleontologist Juliana Manso Sayão described a new genus of coelurosaur from the Romualdo Formation, Aratasaurus.

facts.statement: A 2022 phylogeny by Rolando and colleagues, which described the megaraptoran Maip, included Zuolong in their analysis.
facts.quote: A recent phylogeny including Zuolong was contained in the paper which described the new taxon Maip, a large megaraptoran from the Late Cretaceous of Argentina by Rolando and colleagues in 2022.

facts.statement: Andrea Cau recovered a similar phylogenetic result for Zuolong in his 2024 study of theropod phylogeny and ontogeny.
